title: Page: from 20 s, almost all requests fail, and it never recovers.
explain: The whole cache is down. Reads go to the database, and the database can take them (it is less than 10% busy). The problem is the retries on API → cache: each read retries the dead cache 3 times and waits for the backoff each time, and it holds an API slot all that time. The API slots fill up, load balancer → API starts to time out and retry, and the number of requests multiplies (a retry storm). The system does not recover. The API servers look the busiest, but they are the victim.
hint: Do not retry the cache: set the retries of API → cache to 0. When the cache does not answer, treat it as a miss and read the database. The database can take it.
